overclaims: Contemporaneous company evidence supports the narrower point that safeguards can improve AI behavior.
checks.note: The excerpt, proposition, conditions and outcome (causal_assessment, not_applicable, unresolved) are all fine. Two problems. First, the rationale calls the evidence 'contemporaneous', but e1 (Mar 2023) and e2 (Feb 2023) come 7–8 months before the 2023-10-10 post, and the contract treats them as earlier context. Second, e2's public excerpt 'with internal testing.' leaves out the negation 'not something we would typically find', so on its own it could suggest the opposite. e1's excerpt also leaves out 'In most cases'.
